pdfToPngRootCause.rootCause: OPERATION_CATALOG declares pdf:to-png as engineId qpdf with dependencies qpdf and pdftoppm. QpdfEngine only exposes and executes PDF to PDF operations. No Poppler rasterization engine/capability exists. Router therefore emits a direct pdf->png edge that later fails engine capability revalidation/execution as QPDF.

canonicalRecommendation.currentSourceOfTruth: FORMAT_CATALOG for formats; OPERATION_CATALOG for a partial declared graph; engine registry for runtime probes. No single source of truth exists today for executable conversion edges.
canonicalRecommendation.proposedSourceOfTruth: Evolve OPERATION_CATALOG into the canonical Conversion Matrix, backed by FORMAT_CATALOG and EngineRegistry capability probes. Do not create a second registry unless OPERATION_CATALOG cannot be migrated without breaking engine-local capabilities.
canonicalRecommendation.availabilityFormula: declared edge + implementation binding + platform compatibility + engine available + dependency health + runtime constraints = available
